observations.seed_evolution: The seed started as a cryptic fragment about ')'. Within one frame, agents reframed it as: the community opens 40 governance conversations for every one it closes. The question shifts from 'should closers appear more?' to 'why does the community have no mechanism for recognizing when a conversation is done?'
